s: Which of the following statements regarding Yudh Abhyas-2026 is incorrect?
o: It was conducted from September 9 to 28, 2026.
It was held at Bikaner and Auli.
It was the 22nd India–USA army exercise.
x: The incorrect statement is that Yudh Abhyas has been conducted since 2005. The exercise has been conducted since 2004; it was the 22nd India–USA army exercise and was held at Bikaner and Auli from September 9 to 28.

s: Which Indian ship was sent for IBSAMAR IX-2026?
x: India sent INS Tarkash for IBSAMAR IX-2026, held at Simon’s Town and False Bay in South Africa. INS Trishul was associated with Konkan-2026, while INS Sahyadri and INS Kulish were listed for other exercises.

s: Exercise Veer Guardian-2026 involved two transport aircraft of which type?
x: Two C-2 transport aircraft were involved in Veer Guardian.

s: Where did the 2nd ASEAN–India Maritime Exercise, AIME-2026, begin on 28 September 2026?
x: AIME-2026 began at Subic Bay in the Philippines on 28 September 2026. Oskemen was the venue of KAZIND-2026, while Vladivostok and Simon’s Town were associated with other exercises.

s: KAZIND-2026, the India–Kazakhstan military exercise, was conducted at which place?
x: The 9th edition of KAZIND-2026 was held at Oskemen, Kazakhstan, from 28 September to 11 October 2026. Chaubattia, Subic Bay and Plymouth were venues associated with other exercises.

s: Which Indian ship took part in the India–Russia naval exercise INDRA-2026?
x: INDRA-2026 involved INS Sahyadri and the Russian corvette Hero of the Russian Federation Aldar Tsydenzhapov.

s: Which Indian ships took part in AIME-2026, the 2nd ASEAN–India Maritime Exercise?
x: India sent INS Sahyadri and INS Kulish to AIME-2026 at Subic Bay, which ran a Harbour phase followed by a Sea phase.

s: Mountain Guardian 2026, the India–UAE joint military exercise, was conducted at which location?
x: Mountain Guardian 2026 was held at the Chaubattia Foreign Training Node in Uttarakhand. Oskemen was associated with KAZIND-2026, while Subic Bay was associated with AIME-2026.

s: Since which year has the INDRA series of India–Russia exercises been conducted?
x: The INDRA series has been conducted since 2003. The other years belong to the starting years of the Konkan series, IBSAMAR’s biennial cycle, and ASEAN’s establishment, respectively.

s: Which of the following is the India–UK Army exercise listed alongside Konkan-2026?
x: Ajeya Warrior is the India–UK Army exercise listed alongside Konkan. Indradhanush is the corresponding Air Force exercise, while IBSAMAR and KAZIND involve different partner countries.

s: From which units was the Indian contingent at KAZIND-2026 mainly drawn?
o: 9 Gorkha Rifles and the Indian Navy
Bhairav Battalion and the Indian Air Force
Garhwal Rifles and the Indian Navy
Garhwal Rifles and the Indian Air Force
x: The 60-member Indian contingent came mainly from the Garhwal Rifles and the IAF.

s:
Assertion (A): IBSAMAR is conducted biennially since 2008.
Reason (R): IBSAMAR is held under the IBSA Dialogue Forum.
o: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is NOT the correct explanation of A
A is true, but R is false
A is false, but R is true

s: Exercise Konkan-2026 forms part of the India–UK Comprehensive Strategic Partnership and which Vision?
x: Konkan-2026 is part of the India–UK Comprehensive Strategic Partnership and Vision 2035.

s: Which exercise was conducted as the 13th India–Sri Lanka naval exercise at Visakhapatnam from September 17 to 21, 2026?
x: SLINEX-26 was the 13th India–Sri Lanka naval exercise, held at Visakhapatnam from September 17 to 21. Varuna-2026 was an India–France naval exercise, while Samudra Laksamana involved India and Malaysia.

s: Where was Veer Guardian-2026, the India–Japan air exercise, conducted?
x: The second edition of Veer Guardian-2026 was conducted at AFS Jodhpur from September 9 to 22. Bikaner and Auli were associated with Yudh Abhyas-2026, while Toulon was the starting venue of Varuna-2026.

s: In which year was the first edition of the multinational air exercise Tarang Shakti held?
x: Tarang Shakti's first edition was in 2024; the 2026 edition had aircraft from 8 countries and 32 observers.

s: Dharma Guardian is the India–Japan exercise of which service?
x: Dharma Guardian is the India–Japan army exercise; JIMEX is the naval one.

s: Exercise Nomadic Elephant-2026 was which edition of the India–Mongolia exercise?
x: It was the 18th edition, with 45 personnel from each side focusing on counter-insurgency under a UN mandate.

s: Which force conducted Exercise Rudra Raptors?
x: Rudra Raptors was an Indian Army exercise, involving the Black Mace Brigade.

s: Which French aircraft carrier took part in the Indo-French naval exercise Varuna-2004?
x: The French nuclear carrier Charles De Gaulle (crew about 1,950) took part in Varuna-2004.

s: Where was the 24th edition of the India–France naval exercise Varuna held in 2026?
x: Varuna-2026, the 24th edition, was held at Toulon, France (began 22 September, concluded 28 September) with INS Trishul. The India–France naval exercise was initiated in 1993 (not 1983) and named Varuna in 2001.

s: Samudra Laksamana is a naval exercise between India and which country?
x: Samudra Laksamana is the India–Malaysia naval exercise; INS Mysore took part at Lumut.

s: Eager Lion-2026, hosted for the first time in the USA, is a military exercise between the USA and which country?
x: Eager Lion is a US–Jordan exercise; its 12th edition was held at Fort Carson, Colorado.

s: What is the capital of Kazakhstan, India's partner in the KAZIND exercise?
x: Kazakhstan's capital is Astana, not Almaty; its currency is the Tenge.

s: Who launched INS Surya (FSS-1), India's first indigenous Fleet Support Ship, at Hindustan Shipyard Ltd, Visakhapatnam, on 6 October 2026?
o: The Chief of the Naval Staff
x: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh launched INS Surya at Hindustan Shipyard Ltd on 6 October 2026.

s: Which of the following statements about INS Surya and Hindustan Shipyard Ltd is incorrect?
o: Hindustan Shipyard Ltd functions under the Ministry of Ports & Shipping.
The ship has a helicopter deck for a Multi-Role Helicopter and self-defence systems.
Slipway-4 can accommodate ships up to 45,000 DWT.
INS Surya is equipped for at-sea replenishment, carrying cargo and fluids, and first-line maintenance.
x: The incorrect statement is that Hindustan Shipyard Ltd functions under the Ministry of Ports & Shipping; it is under the Ministry of Defence. The other statements correctly describe INS Surya’s capabilities and Slipway-4’s capacity.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about SAREX-2026?
o: It was conducted by the Indian Coast Guard off Paradip, Odisha, from 7 to 8 October 2026.
Its Mass Rescue Operation scenario involved an aircraft ditching with 228 people.
x: SAREX-2026 deployed 15 ICG ships, not 14.

s: In which year was Project Seabird, whose Phase-IIA infrastructure at INS Kadamba, Karwar, was inaugurated in 2026, approved?
x: Project Seabird was approved in 1985, not 2005.

s: At which location was ALH Mk-III CG 875 inducted into the Coast Guard Region (West)?
x: ALH Mk-III CG 875 was inducted at ICGAS Ratnagiri, Maharashtra. Mumbai is the headquarters of Coast Guard Region (West), while Bengaluru is associated with HAL.

s: Which company makes TROUT, the first indigenous military-grade underwater ROV delivered to the Indian Navy?
x: Kerala start-up EyeROV makes TROUT; it has delivered 2 of the 5 ordered.

s: With reference to Hindustan Shipyard Ltd (HSL), which pair is correctly matched?
o: Jala Usha – Five Fleet Support Ships of about 43,500 tonnes
Vizag maritime hub – First ship built in independent India
x: HSL was established in 1941. Jala Usha (1948) was the first ship built in independent India, and the FSS programme covers five ships of about 43,500 tonnes.

s: What is the motto of the Indian Coast Guard?
x: The Indian Coast Guard's motto is 'Vayam Rakshamah'; it was established on 1 February 1977.

s: In which year was Garden Reach Shipbuilders and Engineers (GRSE), which launched the patrol vessel 'Shreyas', established?
x: GRSE was established in 1884 and delivered INS Ajay in 1961.

s: Under Project Seabird Phase-IIA, which description correctly identifies the institutional role of the Chief of Defence Staff (CDS)?
o: Chief of the Navy and head of the Department of Military Affairs
Permanent Chairman of the Chiefs of Staff Committee and head of Project Seabird
Permanent Chairman of the Chiefs of Staff Committee and head of the Department of Military Affairs
Chairman of the Western Naval Command and head of the Department of Military Affairs
x: The CDS is the Permanent Chairman of the Chiefs of Staff Committee and heads the Department of Military Affairs. The other options incorrectly substitute Project Seabird, the Navy, or the Western Naval Command for this role.

s: Who was the first Indian woman to summit Mount Everest?
x: Bachendri Pal became the first Indian woman to summit Everest on 23 May 1984.

s: Where and when was the third indigenous Anti-Submarine Warfare Shallow Water Craft (ASW-SWC) “Mangrol” inducted into the Indian Navy?
o: At Cochin Shipyard, Kochi, on 12 October 2026
At Naval Dockyard, Mumbai, on 7 April 2004
At Naval Dockyard, Mumbai, on 12 October 2026
At Naval Dockyard, Visakhapatnam, on 12 October 2026
x: Mangrol, the third indigenous ASW-SWC built by Cochin Shipyard Ltd, was inducted at Naval Dockyard, Mumbai, on 12 October 2026. The date 7 April 2004 refers to the end of service of the earlier minesweeper INS Mangrol, while Kochi and Visakhapatnam are associated with Cochin Shipyard and the Eastern Naval Command, respectively.

s: At which place was ICGS Savitribai Phule decommissioned after about 20 years of service?
x: ICGS Savitribai Phule was decommissioned at Karwar after about 20 years of service. Mumbai was the decommissioning place of ICGS Subhadra Kumari Chauhan, while Okha was associated with ICGS Meera Behn.

s: Which Next Generation Patrol Vessel was launched by GRSE at Kolkata on 10 October 2026?
x: Shreyas was launched at Kolkata by GRSE on 10 October 2026 as the third Next Generation Patrol Vessel. Sanghamitra and Shruti preceded it in the series, while INS Ajay was an earlier indigenous warship delivered by GRSE.

s: Where was ICGS Subhadra Kumari Chauhan decommissioned on 27 August 2026?
x: ICGS Subhadra Kumari Chauhan was decommissioned at Mumbai; ICGS Meera Behn at Okha and ICGS Savitribai Phule at Karwar.

s:

Reason (R): An AUV operates autonomously, whereas an ROV is remotely operated.
o: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is NOT the correct explanation of A
A is true, but R is false
A is false, but R is true

s: With reference to ICGS Ajit, which of the following statements is incorrect?
o: It is a Fast Patrol Vessel built by Goa Shipyard Ltd.
It is based at Vasco da Gama, Gujarat.
It was commissioned by Dr Sirish Choudhary.

s: With reference to IAF No. 17 Squadron 'Golden Arrows', which pair is correctly matched?
x: Vampire jets came in 1955. The squadron began with 12 Harvard-II Bs, now flies Rafales, and took part in Operation Sindoor in May 2025.

s: Which was the first ship built in independent India, at Visakhapatnam in 1948?
x: Jala Usha (1948), built at Visakhapatnam, was the first ship built in independent India.

s: Which shipyard became the first Indian shipyard to deliver an indigenous warship, INS Ajay, in 1961?
x: GRSE, Kolkata (est. 1884) delivered INS Ajay in 1961, the first indigenous warship from an Indian yard.

s: ICGS Meera Behn was decommissioned at Okha in August 2026. What was the original name of Meera Behn?
x: Meera Behn, Gandhi's British follower, was born Madeleine Slade.

s: INS Sarvekshak, the first Indian naval ship to install a solar power system on board (2017), is what type of vessel?
x: INS Sarvekshak is a hydrographic survey ship; in February 2017 it became the first Navy ship to go green with solar panels.

s: How many flexible solar panels of 300 W each were installed on INS Sarvekshak under the Navy's Green Initiative?
x: INS Sarvekshak was fitted with 18 lightweight flexible solar panels of 300 W each.

s: Who became the oldest Indian woman to climb Mount Everest on 19 May 2024?
x: Jyoti Ratre of Madhya Pradesh, aged 55, became the oldest Indian woman on Everest, beating Sangeeta Bahl's record.

s: Which of the following pairs (exercise – venue) is correctly matched?
x: ReSAREX-26 was held off Mumbai. Varuna-2026 was at Toulon, Samudra Laksamana at Lumut and the CSC TTX at Eastern Naval Command, Visakhapatnam.

s: Samarthak is the first of how many Multi-Purpose Vessels being built for the Indian Navy?
x: Samarthak is the first of four MPVs, with surveillance, patrol, target-deployment and unmanned-support roles.

s: In which year was the Innovations for Defence Excellence (iDEX) initiative launched?
x: iDEX was launched in 2018, not 2019.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Indian Coast Guard?
o: Its headquarters is in New Delhi
It works under the Ministry of Home Affairs
x: The Indian Coast Guard works under the Ministry of Defence, not the Ministry of Home Affairs.

s: The Advanced Light Helicopter (ALH) Mk-III inducted into the Coast Guard in October 2026 is built by which company?
x: The ALH is built by HAL (Hindustan Aeronautics Limited), set up in 1940 with headquarters in Bengaluru.

s: Samarthak, the Indian Navy's first indigenous Multi-Purpose Vessel, was built by which company?
x: Samarthak was built by L&T under Make in India.

s: Where was Samarthak, the Indian Navy's first indigenous Multi-Purpose Vessel, inducted on 16 October 2026?
x: Samarthak was inducted at Karwar Naval Base on 16 October 2026; it is the first of four MPVs.

s: On which date was INS Kadamba at Karwar, developed under Project Seabird, commissioned?
x: INS Kadamba (Project Seabird) was commissioned on 31 May 2005.

s:

Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A

s: 'Wings Over Ganga', the IAF air show at Namo Ghat, Varanasi, marked which anniversary of the IAF?
x: The air show, which ended on 25 October 2026, marked the IAF's 94th anniversary.

s: Which company builds Tejas, designed by ADA, which took part in 'Wings Over Ganga' at Varanasi?
x: Tejas is designed by ADA and built by HAL; Su-30MKI and LCH Prachand also flew at Namo Ghat.

s: At which shipyard was NGOPV 'Srishti' (Yard 1283) launched on 27 October 2026?
x: Srishti was launched at Goa Shipyard.

s: Which shipyards are building the Next Generation Offshore Patrol Vessels (NGOPVs) for the Navy?
x: NGOPVs are built by Goa Shipyard Limited and GRSE; 'Srishti' was launched by Sandeepa Sahay.

s: On which date did the Rafale-M first land on INS Vikrant?
x: Rafale-M landed on INS Vikrant on 29 October 2026, in its first attempt.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about INS Vikrant and the Rafale-M?
o: INS Vikrant was commissioned on 2 September 2022
INS Vikrant was built by Cochin Shipyard
INS Vikrant is a STOBAR carrier
The deal for 36 Rafale-M was signed in April 2025
x: The April 2025 deal was for 26 Rafale-M, not 36.

s: BAM-H24, which received an Indian patent for a high-energy rocket-propellant material, was developed by which combination?
o: DRDO and ACRHEM of the University of Hyderabad
x: BAM-H24 was developed by DRDO and the Advanced Centre of Research in High Energy Materials at the University of Hyderabad. NASA and SpaceX were associated with the Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope, while Google and Planet were associated with Project Suncatcher.

s: What was the theme of VIMARSH 2026, held by the Ministry of Defence in New Delhi on September 15, 2026?
x: The theme was 'Varta se Vikas'; the meet links DRDO with industry, MSMEs, deep-tech start-ups and academia.

s: The SAT-SAAW contract with Bharat Dynamics Limited relates to which of the following?
o: 160 loitering munitions under a ₹50 crore contract
100 Javelin missiles under a USD 45.7 million package
70 HTT-40 trainers under a ₹810 crore contract
160 Satellite Smart Anti-Airfield Weapons under a ₹810 crore contract
x: SAT-SAAW is covered by a ₹810 crore contract with BDL for 160 Satellite Smart Anti-Airfield Weapons. The weapon is DRDO-designed and intended for use against runways and airfields.

s: Which of the following statements about Khagantak-243 is incorrect?
o: It is a long-range glide bomb.
It was developed by JSR Dynamics.
It is a satellite-guided anti-airfield weapon developed by BDL.
It underwent an Indian Air Force drop test.

s: Besides solar power, which gas does DRDO's indigenous High-Altitude Platform System, a stratospheric airship, use?
x: The HAPS uses solar power and helium (not hydrogen); it reached 21 km and stayed stable at 20 km for over 30 minutes.

s: With reference to the BrahMos missile system, which pair is correctly matched?
o: Development partnership – HAL and NPO Mashinostroyenia

s: In the DRDO technology-development context, what does SHIELD stand for?
o: Satellite High-Intensity Electronic Launch and Defence
S-band High-Power Microwave Integrated Evaluation for Lethality and Damage
Strategic High-Energy Infrared Laser for Detection
S-band Hypersonic Integrated Electronic Launch Device
x: SHIELD stands for S-band High-Power Microwave Integrated Evaluation for Lethality and Damage. It is being developed under the Technology Development Fund.

s: On 6 October 2026, the Ministry of Defence signed a ₹661.50-crore contract with BrahMos Aerospace Pvt Ltd for which purpose?
o: Submarine propulsion systems for the Navy
Long-range radars for the Indian Air Force
Fire Control and Launch Systems for Navy ships
Unmanned aerial vehicles for border surveillance
x: The ₹661.50-crore contract was for Fire Control and Launch Systems for Navy ships. The contract was not for radars, submarine propulsion systems or unmanned aerial vehicles.

s: Who announced the Indian Army's 'SAMARTH' vision?
x: General Dhiraj Seth announced the Army's SAMARTH vision; the President is the Supreme Commander.

s: The indigenous High-Altitude Platform System tested by DRDO was developed as a stratospheric airship by which establishment?
x: The stratospheric airship was developed by ADRDE in Agra under DRDO. The other options name different organisations or locations not associated with this system.

s: Which motto and establishment year correctly belong to the Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO)?
x: DRDO was established in 1958 and its motto is “Balasya Mulam Vigyanam.” The other options combine different mottos or establishment years.

s: Who is the Supreme Commander of the Indian Army?
x: The President of India is the Supreme Commander of the Indian Army.

s: The Akash air defence system was exported to which two countries by 1 October 2026?
x: Akash was exported to Tajikistan and Turkmenistan by 1 October 2026. Armenia is a tempting trap because it was the first foreign user of Akash, but it is not one of the two countries named for this export.

s: The TASL–Javelin joint venture MoU concerns final assembly in India of which weapon?
x: The MoU concerns final assembly in India of the FGM-148 Javelin. The joint venture is between Lockheed Martin and RTX.

s: What is the name of India's own fifth-generation fighter programme, which it continues while holding only Dialogue Partner status in GCAP?
x: India is a GCAP Dialogue Partner, not a member, and continues the fifth-generation AMCA.

s: To which procurement framework is RAKSHA, the 10-year Defence Diplomacy Action Document, linked?
x: The framework is linked to DAP-2020, not DAP-2015; Rajnath Singh released RAKSHA on September 3, 2026.

s: What does the letter H stand for in the Indian Army's 'SAMARTH' vision?
x: H stands for Human–Machine Teaming; M is Modernisation & Mission Readiness and T is Technology.

s: Which country was the first foreign user of the Akash air-defence system?
x: Armenia was the first foreign user of Akash, which is developed by DRDO and made by BDL and BEL.

s: Which company makes HUMSA-2020-NG Mk-2?
x: BEL makes HUMSA-2020-NG Mk-2; NSTL Visakhapatnam tested the MP-AUV.

s: Where was the FWDA–Keydef partnership for AI-enabled drones, aimed at NATO certification, signed?
x: The partnership was signed at Braga, Portugal, not Lisbon.

s: Why does BAM-H24 offer better solid rocket-propellant performance?
o: low specific impulse and low ignition delay
high specific impulse and high ignition delay
high specific impulse and low ignition delay
low specific impulse and high ignition delay
x: BAM-H24 has high specific impulse and low ignition delay; higher specific impulse means better propulsion per unit propellant.

s: With which Russian company did DRDO set up BrahMos Aerospace as a joint venture in 1998?
x: BrahMos is a JV of DRDO and Russia's NPO Mashinostroyenia; its name joins Brahmaputra and Moskva.

s: Which Defence PSUs make DRDO's Akash surface-to-air missile?
x: Akash, designed by DRDO, is made by Bharat Dynamics Ltd and Bharat Electronics Ltd.

s: Which countries are developing the GCAP sixth-generation fighter, in which India got 'Dialogue Partner' status?
x: GCAP is a UK–Japan–Italy programme launched in December 2022; India is only a Dialogue Partner.

s: Which DRDO laboratory at Visakhapatnam tested the Man-Portable Autonomous Underwater Vehicle that detects mines by sonar?
x: The Naval Science and Technological Laboratory (NSTL), Visakhapatnam, tested the MP-AUV.

s: For which use is Zero mK India (Alwar), the first high-value deep-tech project under the TDF, building a 20 mK dilution refrigerator?
x: Its dilution refrigerator, cooling to 20 millikelvin, is meant for quantum computing.

s: What is HAL's HTT-40 'Ankur', of which the first 3 of 70 were delivered?
x: HTT-40 'Ankur' is HAL's basic trainer aircraft.

s: Where was the first edition of the IAF Dronathon held in September 2026?
x: IAF Dronathon-2026, its first edition, was held at Pokhran from 14 to 16 September.

s: In which year was DRDO, which functions under the Ministry of Defence, established?
x: DRDO was established in 1958 and works under the Department of Defence R&D, Ministry of Defence.

s: Which institute partnered with the Army Air Defence College, Gopalpur, to offer an M.Tech in Defence Technology for officers on September 10, 2026?
x: IIT Ropar partnered with the Army Air Defence College, Gopalpur, for the M.Tech in Defence Technology for officers. IIT-BHU was associated with an electric mobility research MoU, not this defence technology programme.

s: Where were the trials of the 30-kW laser directed-energy weapon conducted in April 2025?
x: The laser trials were held at NOAR, Kurnool, in April 2025.

s: The 'Greater Than Us' campaign launched by Rajnath Singh at IIT Kanpur aims to raise how much by March 2029?
x: The campaign aims to raise USD 1 billion by March 2029.

s: With whose help was IIT Kanpur, home to the new Defence Drone Hub, set up in 1959?
x: IIT Kanpur was set up in 1959 with a consortium of nine US universities (KIAP).

s: Which company is developing Jwala-MK1, India's first private-sector micro missile?
x: Jwala-MK1 is developed by IG Defence.

s: What is a counter-drone system such as Jwala-MK1, which destroys its target, called?
x: A hard-kill system destroys the target; a soft-kill system jams or spoofs it.

s: What type of weapon is Jwala-MK1, India's first private-sector micro missile?
o: short-range surface-to-air missile for the counter-drone role
x: Jwala-MK1 is a short-range counter-drone SAM; its October 2026 tests were of a solid rocket motor.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the defence contracts signed in October 2026?
o: The ₹2,563 crore contract with NSIL is for GSAT-7C for the Indian Air Force
The ₹1,543 crore contract with BDL is for Varunastra torpedoes for the Navy
Varunastra is a lightweight torpedo developed by ISRO

s: Where is Bharat Dynamics Limited (BDL), which got the ₹1,543 crore Varunastra contract in October 2026, headquartered?
x: BDL was set up in 1970 and is headquartered in Hyderabad.

s: What was the total value of the contracts signed in October 2026 for GSAT-7C and Varunastra torpedoes?
x: The two contracts (₹2,563 crore + ₹1,543 crore) total ₹4,106 crore.

s: Which DRDO laboratory developed the portable ELINT system to detect enemy radars and drones?
x: The portable ELINT system is by DLRL, Hyderabad.

s: The armour plates developed by R&DE(E), Pune, about 20% lighter, meet which NATO STANAG 4569 level?
x: The plates meet NATO STANAG 4569 Level-6 and stop 30 mm armour-piercing rounds.

s: Where will Raksha Expo-2026, India's first defence-aerospace expo by a State Government, be held?
x: Raksha Expo-2026 will be held at Bharat Future City, Hyderabad.

s: On which dates will Raksha Expo-2026, part of the Invest Telangana Global Summit, be held?
x: Raksha Expo-2026 runs 7–9 December 2026, with its air show on 9 December.

s: Which company made the Nagastra-2 anti-tank loitering munitions delivered to the Army?
x: Nagastra-2 is made by Solar Defence and Aerospace, Nagpur.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about Nagastra-2?
o: It can be recalled within 50 km
It carries a 4 kg tandem shaped charge
It has an endurance of 60 minutes
x: Nagastra-2 can be recalled within 25 km; it is fire-and-forget up to 50 km.

s: From which site was Pralay tested on 4 November 2026?
x: Pralay was tested from Launch Complex-3, ITR Chandipur (Balasore), Odisha.

s: What type of missile is Pralay, tested on 4 November 2026?
x: Pralay is a solid-fuelled short-range surface-to-surface quasi-ballistic missile; it hit two targets about 500 km away.

s: Who was the DRDO Chairman at the time of the Pralay test on 4 November 2026?
x: The DRDO Chairman is Rajesh Kumar Singh.

s: How much does the fire protection suit developed by IIT Delhi and DRDO weigh?
x: The suit weighs 2.2 kg, against about 10 kg for a conventional suit.

s: Up to what temperature can the IIT Delhi–DRDO fire protection suit withstand?
x: The suit withstands up to 1,300°C and costs ₹30,000–40,000; imported suits cost ₹1–3 lakh.

s: Which company developed TAPAS-1, described as India's first private commercial thermal-imaging payload?
x: TAPAS-1 was developed by Satleo Labs of Ahmedabad and is a 1.5-kg CubeSat payload described as an orbital thermometer. TakeMe2Space, Space Zone India and Skyroot Aerospace are associated with other space initiatives in the news.

s: Who among the following was named in TIME100 Next–2026?
x: Pawan Kumar Chandana, co-founder and CEO of Skyroot Aerospace, was named in TIME100 Next–2026. Mayilsamy Annadurai, Shravan Singh Bhati and Bhaskar Kanseri are associated with other space or quantum-technology developments.

s: NASA’s Dragonfly mission to Titan is scheduled for launch in which month and year, using what power source?
x: NASA’s Dragonfly mission to Titan is scheduled for July 2028 and will use a radioisotope generator. The other options alter the launch schedule or the power source.

s: In the context of additive manufacturing, which pair is correctly matched?
x: Agnikul Cosmos is IIT Madras incubated. Agnibaan SOrTeD flew in May 2024 and the Indian Army 3D-printed dwelling is at Ahmedabad.
